sentences.text: Accused nos.1 to 5 are before this Court under Section 482 Cr.PC with a prayer to quash the entire proceedings in NC: 2024:KHC-K:4950 C.C.No.7746/2022 pending before the Court of IV Addl.

Civil Judge & JMFC-III, Vijayapura, arising out of Crime No.27/2022 registered by Women Police Station, Vijayapura, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 read with 149 IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.
3.

Learned Counsel for the petitioners and the learned Counsel for respondent no.2 at the inception jointly submit that the parties have filed an application under Section 482 Cr.PC reporting settlement.
4. The application filed by the parties is supported by the affidavits of petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2.

In paragraphs 2 to 5 of the affidavit filed by respondent no.2, it is stated as under:
"2. I had lodged a complaint against petitioners for the offences punishable U/S.
498A, 323, 504, R/w. S.149 IPC along with S.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act & after investigation the chargesheet has been filed & same is pending in Criminal Case No.7746/2022 before the Hon'ble IV Addl. Civil Judge & JMFC-III Court, Vijayapura for NC: 2024:KHC-K:4950 just disposal.

entities.text: IV Addl. Civil Judge & JMFC-III Court, Vijayapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned Magistrate had taken cognizance & issued process against us vide Order Dt. 11.07.2022 for the offences punishable U/S.498A, 323, 504, R/w. S.149 IPC along with S.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Now during the pendency of the proceedings, due to the intervention of elders &
well-wishers of both the side as well as in order to part way and to lead peaceful &
harmonious life, we have mutually resolved to put an end to the litigations pending between myself & the petitioners by amicably settling the disputes.
The offences alleged against the petitioners are in the nature of private wrong and has no bearing of the public good.

The dispute is an offshoot of criminal case filed against my brother by the petitioner no.1.
4.

In view of settlement between the parties, the parties have mutually agreed to withdraw the following litigations between ourselves:
i.
The Criminal Case No.4419/2022 (arising out of Vijayapura Jala Nagar PS. Crime No.10/2022) pending before the Hon'ble III Addl. Senior Civil & JMFC, Court,

entities.text: III Addl. Senior Civil & JMFC, Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Vijayapura

for the offences punishable U/S. 143, 147, 341, 323, 326, 504, 506 R/w.
S.149 IPC against my brother & relatives filed NC: 2024:KHC-K:4950 by the Petitioner No.1 has been settled & compromised and agreed to be quashed as having been settled between the parties.
ii.

The maintenance case viz., Crl. Misc.
Praveen And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132913966/
3 No.56/2023 filed by me against the Petitioner No.1 pending on the file of Addl.

Crl. Misc.
Praveen And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Court, Basavanabagewadi will be withdrawn at the earliest with no future claims in future.

It is mutually agreed that there would be no claims of whatsoever nature by the me against the Petitioner No.1.
iii.

It is mutually agreed that the parties will facilitate as well as expedite in disposal of mutual consent divorce filed viz., M.C.No.206/2024 pending on the file of Hon'ble Family Court, Vijayapura.
iv.
The present Criminal Case No.7746/2022 pending on the file of Hon'ble IV Addl

. 
Civil Judge & JMFC-III Court, Vijayapura, for the offences punishable U/S.498A,
323, 504, R/w. S.149 IPC along with S.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act be quashed as settled.
The parties have mutually agreed that there shall be no litigation of any kind filed against each other.

5. In view of the settlement between us, I do not intend to pursue this criminal case against the petitioner."
5.
The parties are present before this Court and are identified by their respective advocates.
The parties are all close relatives.
It is stated in the affidavit that the settlement between the parties is voluntary, without there being any undue influence and coercion.

The allegations in the case is purely private in nature.
6.

The Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of RAMGOPAL AND ANOTHER VS. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH - AIR 2022 (14) SCC 531 has observed that notwithstanding the limitations provided under Section 320 of Cr.P.C., the High Court can exercise its inherent powers under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. and quash criminal proceedings registered for non-compoundable offences considering the nature of allegations, gravity of offence and the nature of settlement arrived at between the parties.

entities.text: RAMGOPAL AND ANOTHER VS. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH - AIR 2022 (14) SCC 531
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The parties in the present case have decided to give a quietus to all the disputes between them and the allegations are not of grave in nature.
The settlement between the parties is voluntary and without there being any undue influence and coercion.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that there should not be any impediment to grant the relief sought for in the application.

Accordingly, the following order:
8.
Criminal petition is allowed.

The entire proceedings in C.C.No.7746/2022 pending before the Court of IV Addl.
